subject: science
passage: Most of the tea grown in the hills around Darjeeling, in the Indian state of West Bengal, comes from the small-leaved Chinese variety of the tea plant rather than the larger-leaved Assam variety common in the plains. Cool temperatures at elevations of up to about 2,000 meters slow the bushes' growth, which is thought to concentrate the compounds that give the leaves their aroma. Picked in March and April, soon after the bushes end their winter dormancy, ______ which is one reason it often sells for more than tea from later harvests.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: the first flush of tender new shoots yields a tea with a light, flowery taste,
choices.B: the light, flowery taste of the first flush of tender new shoots is prized by growers,
choices.C: a light, flowery taste is what growers prize in the first flush of tender new shoots,
choices.D: growers prize the first flush of tender new shoots for its light, flowery taste,

explanation.why: The introductory phrase "Picked in March and April, soon after the bushes end their winter dormancy" describes what is picked: the new shoots of the first flush. A modifier at the start of a sentence applies to the subject that comes right after the comma, so that subject must be "the first flush of tender new shoots."
explanation.A: Correct. "The first flush of tender new shoots" comes right after the introductory phrase, so it is clear that the shoots are what was picked.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The subject is "taste"; a taste is not something that can be picked.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This makes "a light, flowery taste" the subject, so the sentence says the taste was picked.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This makes "growers" the subject, so the sentence says the growers were picked in March and April.
